newsitem.title: USA: Boeing awarded $216 mln bomber contract.
newsitem.headline: Boeing awarded $216 mln bomber contract.

text.p: Boeing Co Wednesday said the U.S. Air Force awarded a $216 million contract with award fee to upgrade defensive systems on the B-1B Lancer bomber.
In a statement, Boeing said the contract provides for engineering and manufacturing development of a new defensive system for the B-1B.

Howard Chambers, Boeing vice president and B-1B program manager, said work on the contract will be done at Boeing facilities in Seal Beach, Calif., Palmdale, Calif. and Edwards Air Force Base, Calif., as well as in Seattle and Oklahoma City.

The engineering and manufacturing development phase is scheduled for completion in 2002 at the conclusion of flight testing at Edwards Air Force Base. Production and installation of the improvements on the 95-aircraft B-1B fleet is scheduled to begin in 2003.
